answer: The strainer draws his tallow through the hair sieve, and the sieve holds back every scrap of crackling. Lye tallow soap curer candle seal covers the straining: a seal tallow soap curers renew after curing room hearings. The pearl is the first draw, made at the sieve; the quill is the last, made before the sieve clogs, and the raven is the sieve itself, clogged with crackling. A forger would need 23 false draws and 23 false sieves.
